relationships.subject: propranolol
relationships.evidence_quote: tongue tumor tissue from propranolol-treated mice (50.1 ± 3.3 pg/ng, n=5) contained significantly less human TNFα compared to vehicle-treated mice

relationships.subject: propranolol
relationships.evidence_quote: Two-way ANOVA treatment by time interaction (p<0.0001) revealed that propranolol exerted an analgesic effect during HSC-3 tumor progression.

relationships.subject: guanethidine
relationships.evidence_quote: Similar to propranolol treatment, Two-way ANOVA treatment by time interaction (p<0.0001) revealed that GTD exerted an analgesic effect during HSC-3 progression.

relationships.subject: C87
